comment: D-EPG-14 (2026-10-29), one fixture for both languages. Playlist tvg-ids carrying C0 controls (TAB, CR, NUL, SOH, VT, FF, US), DEL, NEL (U+0085), U+2028 and U+2029, each INSIDE the id (str.strip takes them at the edges), beside a plain id. tests/test_epg_id_controls.py and tests/Model.test.js each write the same playlist and guide from it -- one channel per id, named 'Fixture channel <case>', and a guide channel g<index> declaring that name, so the window and epg-now.json are keyed by the RAW playlist tvg-id -- run the SHIPPING helper's playlist and epg verbs over them, and read what it wrote: json.loads, epg --now-only, and Model.parseEpgNowStore / Model.epgEntry. Until D-EPG-14 the helper wrote every C0 control raw: one such id made epg-now.json invalid for the whole source, and a TAB ended the fetch in `internal`. DEL, NEL, U+2028 and U+2029 are valid raw inside a JSON string and split no line any reader splits, so they pin that nothing needs to change for them. ASCII only: every character is a \u escape.
